text:
emily.partnerships: FYI partner reported a batch of negative usage adjustments from their compact edge devices — looks like credits hit several accounts. Can we triage?

alex.metering: ugh. any raw payload samples from the partner?

carla.hw-partner: sending an example they forwarded. they say edge box rolled back counters on power cycle. payload:```{
  "device_id": "edge-42",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-19T22:11:08Z",
  "cumulative_tokens": -120
}``` they also attached a CSV with ~1200 rows of similar deltas.

priya.sre: tagging for observability — @alex.metering do we have ingestion-side guards against negative cumulative counters?

alex.metering: we have a dedupe + monotonic check in the collector but looks like the HW pushed negative cumulative value (not delta). collector treats report as absolute cumulatives and computes delta = cur - prev, so negatives slip through if device resets and reports signed int. need guard to ignore if cur < prev by large margin or treat resets as zero.

ben.finance: how many customers impacted? we saw a credit event in billing for acct ids: 345, 678, 999. rough delta $1.2k across last billing run. if this repeats could be material.

emily.partnerships: partner says this happens when device loses time + battery swap. they want a patch on their firmware but asking if we can short-term filter at ingestion.

alex.metering: short-term plan: 1) drop any reported cumulative < 0 (simple) 2) if cur < prev and cur > 0, treat as device reset — use cur as new base, set delta = cur (not negative) 3) create alert if device has >5 resets in 24h. I can push a canary rule in collector.

priya.sre: we should avoid silent data loss. propose setting a flag on the event so downstream billing can apply manual review for affected windows. also will add a trace id to logs for replay.

carla.hw-partner: def will patch firmware, ETA 2 weeks. can you share the pattern so we can add an HMAC timestamp check?

alex.metering: will send a simple spec. snippet for collector rule:```python
# pseudocode
if cumulative < 0:
  drop()
elif cumulative < previous_cumulative:
  if cumulative == 0 or cumulative < reset_threshold:
    delta = cumulative
    mark_as_reset = True
  else:
    delta = cumulative  # treat as reset but flag for QA
```

ben.finance: please put impacted accounts into a manual review queue before auto-credit reversal. we need ledger entries to be auditable.

accounting-bot: alert created: ACCT-REVIEW-2100009999 assigned to ben.finance (priority: high)

emily.partnerships: next steps: 1) @alex.metering implement canary filter + add trace id (today) 2) @priya.sre add alert + replayable logs (today) 3) @carla.hw-partner firmware patch + HMAC timestamp (2w) 4) @ben.finance manual review of flagged accounts (this week). I'll coordinate comms to the partner and affected customers.

alex.metering: starting canary now, will post logs in #eng-runtime when up.

priya.sre: added trace header and replay job in staging — will validate with a small sample from partner before rollout.

carla.hw-partner: thanks, sending sample batch of 50 device reports to staging endpoint in 10m.

ben.finance: I'll hold credits until we confirm the filter results. thx. :thumbsup:

emily.partnerships: perfect. tagging this thread as the source for the postmortem if we need one. keep updates here. :sparkles:
